Landlord: It seems she didn’t recognize me.
Landlord: Anon! Make sure to take a picture of my better side so that I can send it to my daughter later! She’s a big fan of this fashion stuff.
You: Sure can do!
I didn’t suspect such a turn of events, but I would lie if I said that I’m not happy with how it played out.
